title: 第25章 冰系冰蔓第26章 说好的信任呢
slug: 全职法师第210章依旧强势
lines: 许照庭看到这结果，脸上露出了满意之色。
一转身，原本等待考官给结果的他忽然注视到一双明亮如雪的眸子。
是穆宁雪！
许照庭脸上布满了惊喜。
他没有想到自己的这场考试已经得到了穆宁雪的注视。
她一定很吃惊吧，毕竟雷系的威力是其他系没法比的。
“宁雪，你觉得如何？”穆贺这位校董笑眯眯的问道。
“一般。”穆宁雪没有再多看一眼，选择了继续前行。
校长和其他几位校领导脸色那么一僵。
不会吧，这么强的雷系还觉得一般，这位少女的眼界得多高啊。
“呵呵，其实很不错了，宁雪她在帝都学府，那里云集全国魔法天才，初阶的雷印释放只是他们的基本功，她会觉得一般只是她习惯用帝都学府的标准去衡量了。”穆卓云笑着解释道，给校长和穆贺几人一个台阶下。
“这么说，许照庭还是很有希望入帝都学府的嘛？”校长也是会走台阶的人，顺势就说道。
其他几个人马上附和了起来，自我陶醉。
“不出意外许照庭会是全校成绩第一的吧。”教导处主任陈光亮说道。
“那可不好说，据我所知八班的穆白可是有一拼之力。”副校长说道。
两人这么一说，穆贺脸上也有了笑容，立刻对穆卓云和穆宁雪道：“大哥，穆白是我们穆氏的子弟，成绩一直都很出色，依我看那边也快到他了，我们过去看看？”
“穆白？哪一家的？”
“就是穆阳的儿子，穆阳不是过世了吗，我看他们母子两在其他地方受人欺凌，所以把他们接到了庄园里住。穆白还是一个很懂事也很争气的孩子，不比我们家族其他孩子差……哦，当然和宁雪是有很大的差距，不过也不失一个可以栽培的好苗子。”穆贺小心翼翼的对穆卓云说道。
庄园大权尽掌握在穆卓云的手上，穆贺也算是老爷，却只是三把手、四把手，和穆卓云没法比的。
“哦，有点印象，那就去看看吧，几位校董意下如何？”穆卓云说道。
中分发黄校董开口道：“既然是你们穆氏子弟，我们还是很感兴趣的。”
一波人开始转移，缓缓的朝着八班的考场走去。
这群人气场很强，领导们在学生们眼中或许是一个飘渺的存在，但穆宁雪怎样一个同龄天才对学生们来说就是一阵最醒脑的。
球场上，男生们一看到有女生在旁边观看，整个人就跟打了鸡血似的，更何况这女生是全校梦寐以求的女神。
“我的天，领导团过来了。”
“还真过来了啊，我手在发抖。”
“来得好，正是我表现的好时机。”
“你表现个毛线，你考核都结束了，一个c的渣渣！”
八班的学生们一下子就淡定不住了。
每个人的命运都在这年度考核上，而只要一个赞许眼神，就能够改变他们一生的领导团此刻也走了过来，这让考试气氛一下子凝重到了极点。
穆贺走在最前面，那位秃顶的考官马上抬起头看了一眼穆贺的眼睛。
穆贺一个暗示，秃顶考官马上就懂了，先假装什么都没有看见，平平淡淡的道：“下一个，穆白！”
穆白眼睛还放在穆宁雪身上，即便同住在一个城堡，这个城堡也大到让穆白根本没有几次和穆宁雪站得这么近。
“穆白，到你了。”穆贺咳嗽了一声，提醒了穆白一句。
穆白这才反应过来。
没办法，他喜欢穆宁雪太多年了，哪怕知道自己不太可能和她走在一起，但他妈也不能容忍被莫凡那种垃圾能够拐跑的，自己要当一个守护者！
是证明自己这么多年努力的时候了！
content_en:
Seeing the result, Xu Zhaoting showed a look of satisfaction on his face.
Turning around, he was waiting for the examiner to give him the results, and suddenly he saw a pair of eyes as bright as snow.
It’s Mu Ningxue!
Xu Zhaoting's face was full of surprise.
He didn't expect that his exam would be watched by Mu Ningxue.
She must be surprised, after all, the power of the thunder element is unmatched by other elements.
…
"Ning Xue, what do you think?" Mu He, the school director, asked with a smile.
"Average." Mu Ningxue didn't take another look and chose to move on.
The principal and several other school leaders looked stiff.
No way, such a strong thunder element is still average. This girl's vision is so high.
"Haha, it's actually pretty good. Ning Xue is in the Imperial Capital Academy, where magic geniuses from all over the country gather. The basic skills of releasing thunder seals are only their basic skills. She would think that it is just her habit of measuring by the standards of the Imperial Capital Academy." Mu Zhuoyun explained with a smile, giving the principal and Mu He a few steps.
"So, Xu Zhaoting still has a good chance of entering the Imperial Academy?" The principal said as he was also good at walking.
Several other people immediately agreed and were narcissistic.
"It's no surprise that Xu Zhaoting will be number one in the school," said Chen Guangliang, director of the Teaching Office.
"That's hard to say. As far as I know, Mu Bai from Class 8 is quite capable," the vice principal said.
When the two said this, Mu He also had a smile on his face, and he immediately said to Mu Zhuoyun and Mu Ningxue: "Brother, Mu Bai is a descendant of our Mu family. His grades have always been excellent. I think he is almost there. Let's go and take a look?"
"Mu Bai? Which family is it from?"
"He is Mu Yang's son. Didn't Mu Yang pass away? I saw that mother and son were bullied in other places, so I took them to live in the manor. Mu Bai is still a very sensible and upbeat child, no worse than other children in our family... Oh, of course there is a big gap between him and Ning Xue, but he is still a good seedling that can be cultivated." Mu He said to Mu Zhuoyun cautiously.
All the power of the manor was in the hands of Mu Zhuoyun. Mu He was considered the master, but he was only the third or fourth in command, incomparable to Mu Zhuoyun.
"Oh, I have an impression. Let's go and take a look. What do the school directors think?" Mu Zhuoyun said.
Principal Huang of Zhongfa School opened his mouth and said, "Since you are a descendant of the Mu family, we are still very interested."
A wave of people began to move, slowly walking towards the examination room of Class 8.
This group of people has a strong aura. The leaders may be ethereal existences in the eyes of the students, but Mu Ningxue, a genius of the same age, is the most alert to the students.
On the court, when the boys saw a girl watching from the side, they felt like they were in a state of excitement, not to mention that this girl was the goddess that the whole school dreamed of.
"Oh my God, the leadership team is here."
"You're really here, my hands are shaking."
“It comes at a good time, it’s a good time for me to perform.”
"You're just showing off, your assessment is over, you're a C piece of scum!"
The students in Class 8 suddenly lost their composure.
Everyone's fate lies in this annual assessment, and the leadership team that can change their lives with just a look of approval has also come over at this moment, which makes the examination atmosphere suddenly tense to the extreme.
Mu He walked in the front. The bald examiner immediately raised his head and glanced into Mu He's eyes.
Mu He gave a hint, and the bald examiner immediately understood. He pretended not to see anything at first, and said calmly: "Next, Mu Bai!"
Mu Bai's eyes were still on Mu Ningxue. Even though they lived in the same castle, the castle was so big that Mu Bai had never stood so close to Mu Ningxue.
"Mu Bai, it's your turn." Mu He coughed and reminded Mu Bai.
Only then did Mu Bai react.
He had no choice but to like Mu Ningxue for too many years. Even though he knew that he was unlikely to be with her, he still couldn't tolerate being abducted by trash like Mo Fan. He wanted to be a guardian!
It’s time to prove your hard work over the years!
